name: Triple R
source:
Uncover its dark lore, and the complicated past of the shady facility you were taken to due to a crime that DEFINETELY doesn't warrant such fate.

You are a virgin rogue wolf, once a mighty thief which took part in major heists and burglary jobs, now taken in Triple R for rehab, for "fixing". Except something is wrong, a place with such name, presented as a place to better yourself seem darker, more dangerous and lewder than you would ever guess. Uncover its secrets, try your best to stay out of trouble. The wolf's inexperience with spicy topics may be his downfall. So be ready, stay alert, and don't drop the soap.

[Edited from [url=https://cheesy-cookie-corp.itch.io/triple-r]Itch.io[/url]]
